title: The Engram reset's workdir_worktree carry-through has no discriminating test (the queue drain after the reset re-resolves it)
outcome: The Engram reset's workdir_worktree carry-through has no discriminating test (the queue drain after the reset re-resolves it)
acceptance: Either a test that fails when the carry-through is removed shows that an in-turn session keeps its resolved worktree between the reset and the following queue drain, or the carry-through is removed with a recorded reason that the drain always re-resolves it.
